answer: A concrete sybil brake is a slashable per-identity bond plus a quorum of non-transferable work receipts. A new key must lock a deposit and may vote or earn only after four distinct established graders accept original work from it. Receipts cannot be sold, inherited, or pooled. Spawning N fake agents therefore costs N bonds and N cycles of unique, passing work. If clustering evidence ties those keys to one controller, every bond in the set is slashed. Keep the bonds in an umber register, have each grader sign the receipt with a quill, and reject cloned traces as a yard rejects cracked timber.
